title: Kenworth T909 5 post Road Train Custom Built FUPS Compliant Bullbar #58
description: Kenworth T909 5 post Road Train Custom Built FUPS Compliant Bullbar. 381 style channel with skirt. Standard 76mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Five post design ensures maximum protection to the bonnet and radiator. 100mm full depth box through to lower cow-catcher bar. LED combination daylight running and indicator repeater lights are fitted to the outer uprights. Minimum bonnet to upright clearance to all for maximum dimension combinations. Cow catcher and four small uprights. Reversible aluminium road train signs. The end panels of the channel and reverse side of the R/Train signs are engraved with computer cut KW Logos. Driving light mounts on upper rail. Provision for front mudflaps, Heavy duty steel backing plate with four access bolts for additional strength & 38mm tow pin. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirement.
